BackendEnv.confirm: unchanged: trusted main-process dialog. Now also gates routine scheduled starts (and every routine step via ActionService), model pulls/imports, integration key storage and checks, and turning clipboard history on. Missing confirm denies all of these.
BackendEnv.clipboard?: {readText(): Promise<string>: NEW optional. Native main owner should pass {readText: async () => clipboard.readText()} from Electron. Absent: clipboard-history reported unavailable, clipboardSetEnabled(true) rejects, status carries a 'not connected' warning.
BackendEnv.appMetrics?: () => AppProcessMetric[]: NEW optional. Pass a reduction of app.getAppMetrics() ({pid,type,cpuPercent,workingSetKB}). Absent: systemResources lists 'app-processes' as unavailable.
BackendEnv.dialogs.saveUsageExport?(defaultName, fo: NEW optional save dialog with a CSV/JSON filter. Absent: falls back to dialogs.saveExport (JSON filter) and the backend forces the .csv/.json extension.

interfaces.Backend: adds routines: RoutineEngine, models: ModelRuntime, integrations: IntegrationService, usage: UsageLedger, clipboard: ClipboardHistory. dispose() stops clipboard polling, disposes routine timers and cancels running model jobs.

methods.routines*: createRoutinesApi(RoutineEngine). Storage: <userData>/routines.json sidecar. Actions port = ActionService.preview/execute, so each step previews and asks its own native confirmation. ids checked with checkId; text/json inputs type-checked. routinesPlanText/PlanModel return preview-only RoutinePlan.
methods.models*: ModelRuntime over the guarded fetch (loopback 'ollama' purpose, pinned to settings.localEndpoint). Guard = env.confirm dialog. modelsSelect options strictly read ({warm?, unloadOthers?} booleans only) and returns only the settings patch; the renderer saves it with saveSettings. modelsSetProfile persists to <userData>/model-profile.json and is restored on restart. modelsPickPackFolder = dialogs.pick('folder') normalized. Chat now uses the selected profile (sendChat profile: models.chatProfile).
methods.integrations*: createIntegrationService with a DPAPI key vault under <userData>/secrets/integrations; the 'anthropic' slot aliases the existing Secrets cloud-key vault so chat and integrations share one key. After set/remove the backend refreshes keyConfigured and invalidates SystemInfo. Prefs in <userData>/integrations.json. Audit lines go to Activity (no key material).
methods.usage*: createUsageLedger persisted to <userData>/usage-ledger.json (loadState on start, saved after setPrices/setBudget). usageReport -> {report, performance} (UsageSummary, matches UsagePanel props). usageSetPrices/usageSetBudget require exactly {prices} / {budget}. usageExport(format) writes via save dialog with atomic temp+rename; cancelled -> {path:null, rows, truncated}.
methods.clipboard*: ClipboardHistory, memory only (persisted:false). Turning on needs env.clipboard, not-safe-launch and the trusted dialog; capture polls every 1.5 s only while enabled; turning off stops polling and clears. clipboardGet/Remove check ids. clipboardPurge returns status.
methods.systemResources: System.resources() (measured only; unavailable list for gpu/temperature/battery/app-processes).
methods.getApiInfo: routines, integrations, model-runtime, usage-ledger, resource-monitor now available (with reasons). clipboard-history available only when env.clipboard is supplied. chat-streaming/chat-cancel/region-capture/ocr/vision/automatic-input remain unavailable.

interfaces.netGuard: createGuardedFetch now receives localEndpoint (loopback traffic pinned to the configured endpoint) and audits all non-loopback allowed traffic (cloud-chat and provider-check) plus every denial.
interfaces.bridges: src/ui/bridges.ts adds USAGE_METHODS/usageBridge -> UsageClient {report, exportAs, setPrices(prices), setBudget(budget)}, CLIPBOARD_METHODS/clipboardBridge -> ClipboardClient, resourcesBridge -> () => Promise<ResourceSnapshot>. Each returns null when the methods are absent (browser preview).

security: No renderer boolean authorizes anything new: routine steps use ActionService (native confirm per step), scheduled starts use env.confirm, model downloads/imports, integration keys/checks and enabling clipboard history all require env.confirm and fail closed without it (tested for routines, integrations and clipboard).
Offline guard retained: model pulls refused offline before any dialog or request; integration checks in offline mode send nothing (tested with fetch log).
Keys stay write-only: no method returns key material; activity log checked for absence of the key (tested).
Clipboard is never read before the user turns history on, and polling stops when turned off (tested).
limitations: electron/main.ts (not owned) does not yet pass env.clipboard, env.appMetrics or dialogs.saveUsageExport, so in the packaged app clipboard history reports 'not connected', app-process metrics report unavailable, and usage export uses the JSON-filtered save dialog (extension still forced). Native main owner/captain should inject these.
Chat replies are not metered: chat.ts exposes no token metrics hook, so the usage ledger records no events automatically (stated in getApiInfo).

RoutineEngine.init() runs inside createBackend, before main.ts creates the window. A scheduled slot that is due at startup asks the trusted confirm, which fails closed without a visible focused window, so it is recorded as declined rather than run.
Integration usage history (integrationsUsage) is in memory and cleared on restart (service design).
No live Ollama, Windows DPAPI or Electron runtime run in this worktree; adapters tested with injected native/fetch/confirm mocks.
The 2 pre-existing models streaming test failures remain for the models owner.
